description: Lesson b3 (pull-up / pull-down): PA0 and PA1 floating inputs (external pull resistors), PC13 LED = PA0, both levels reported every 100 ms on USART1
expect: 72 MHz. PA0 and PA1 are floating inputs (GPIO_NOPULL): the lesson circuit gives PA0 an external 10 kohm pull-up to 3V3 + push-button to GND and PA1 an external 10 kohm pull-down to GND + push-button to 3V3. PC13 (on-board LED, active low) push-pull follows PA0 within 2.5 ms (LED on while the PA0 button is pressed). USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1: 'PA0=x PA1=y\r\n' (x, y = 0/1) right after init, then every 100 ms on a SysTick wake-up (+-20 us between lines; the first periodic line 99.8-100.05 ms after the boot line, which is not tick-aligned). Released buttons with the pull resistors: PA0=1 PA1=0. Without the external resistors the inputs float (undefined levels).

circuit: USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)

scenarios.name: PA0 button pressed (to GND) overrides the pull-up
PA1 button pressed (to 3V3) overrides the pull-down
